title: Write pages
description: Each page is one JSON file in content/. Sections can mix paragraphs, lists, tables, code, notices, diagrams, endpoints, and link cards.

sections.title: Create a page file
paragraphs: Put the file anywhere under content/. The folder does not set the URL; the path field does. Keep paths under /docs so the prerender and navigation stay consistent.

sections.title: Ordering
paragraphs: Pages sort by group order from brand.json, then by an optional order number, then by title. Continue reading links follow the same order.

sections.title: Section blocks
paragraphs: A section renders its blocks in a fixed order: heading or endpoint, paragraphs, notice, diagram, list, table, code, and link cards. Omit any block you do not need.
items: paragraphs: an array of plain-text paragraphs.
table: rows of cells; the first row is the header.
code and language: a highlighted, copyable block. The language label picks the highlighter.
links: cards to other pages, with an optional icon.

sections.title: Sequence diagrams
paragraphs: A diagram lists actors and steps. Each step is [from, to, label] by actor index; equal indexes draw a self-step. The same data exports as Mermaid in Copy as Markdown, and CI parses it.
